coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 1180 Fourth Street
record.summary: A 150-unit affordable apartment building at 1180 Fourth Street in Mission Bay South, for very-low- and low-income families and 50 formerly homeless households, developed by Mercy Housing California and designed by Kennerly Architecture & Planning with Mithun|Solomon. DataSF's Assessor tax roll records the parcel's construction year as 2015, and Mercy Housing held its official opening celebration on May 6, 2015.
